contract.purpose: MentionPilot helps founders and marketing teams inspect how configured AI endpoints and supported community sources describe each brand, using retained evidence and accountable follow-up tasks.
contract.canonicalPurpose: Show how configured AI assistants and supported community sources describe a brand.
contract.audience: Founders and marketing teams managing several owned brands.
contract.job: Review retained answers and download the latest project evidence as JSON.
contract.thesis: Carry Signal Room into a working research desk; keep evidence and the active brand obvious.
contract.system: Warm paper #F2EEE5, ink #171613, muted ink #625E56, restrained coral #A92E24 actions, rules #C9C0B1. Georgia findings and headings, existing sans controls, mono receipts. Mostly square paper surfaces, readable line lengths, persistent desktop rail and native mobile selector.
contract.signature: Named brand case files, evidence receipts and a visible saved schedule state.
contract.risk: Editorial typography can reduce density; constrain headings and retain compact controls so multi-project operation remains quick.
contract.qualityBar: Preserve the selected Signal Room design. Label source and returned model. Report download calls the existing authenticated report endpoint, excludes credentials, and has visible failure state; older selected history is not presented as the latest export.
